caseNameFull: Foster v. Thaler, Director, Texas Department of Criminal Justice, Correctional Institutions Division
judges: Application, Burg, Execution, Gins, Grant, Sotomayor, Stay

opinions.text:
C. A. 5th Cir. Application for stay of execution of sentence of death, presented to Justice Scalia, and by him referred to the Court, denied. Certiorari denied.

Justice Gins*969burg, Justice Sotomayor, and Justice Kagan would grant the application for stay of execution.
